Dear compatriot, I must confess that my ardour is not such as to precipitate a conflagration of unbridled fervour, but rather to kindle a modest, yet fervent, spark within the recesses of thy breast. I yearn to initiate a gentle, yet unyielding, flame that shall illuminate the very marrow of thy being, and imbue thy existence with a sense of purpose and devotion.
